cta_worker: Short on time? Write about yourself — AI will fill everything in
cta_worker_desc: No forms to fill: write 2–3 sentences and AI will sort the rest into sections
cta_employer: Describe the job in your own words — AI will turn it into a polished listing
cta_employer_desc: Category, salary, schedule, requirements — AI extracts it all, you just review

worker.title: Tell us about yourself
worker.subtitle: In plain words, as if talking to a friend. AI will put everything in the right sections
worker.placeholder: For example: My name is Aziza Karimova, I'm 24. I live in Tashkent, Chilanzar district. I worked as a shop sales assistant for 3 years and know the cash register and 1C. I speak Uzbek and Russian. I'd like a salary of 4–5 million UZS per month and can start tomorrow.
worker.hints: Name and age | Your profession | Experience | Where you live | Expected salary | When you can start
worker.review_subtitle: Please review. If something's wrong, you can fix it in the next steps

employer.title: Describe the job
employer.subtitle: Who you need, where, the salary and conditions — write freely. AI will prepare a polished listing
employer.placeholder: For example: Our cafe in Chilanzar needs a cook. 1+ year of experience. Working hours 9:00–21:00, 2/2 schedule. Salary 6–8 million, free meals and transport. Official employment.
employer.hints: Position | Address | Salary | Working hours | Requirements | Benefits

analyzing: Reading the text… | Sorting into sections… | Choosing a category… | Writing a polished text… | Almost done…

cta_worker_update_desc: Describe what has changed in plain words — AI will update the right sections for you
